findings.claim: The repair-kbd-memory-rest-contract change is archived in this diff after editing generator-consumed skill sources without regenerating or committing any distribution outputs, breaching constraint C-01 with no sanctioned deferral path.
findings.evidence: C-01: 'Any change that edits a source consumed by a generator must regenerate + commit the outputs... a violation marks the change BLOCKED.' The diff edits skills/process/kbd-process-orchestrator/** (SKILL.md, references, shell scripts, tests) and simultaneously renames openspec/changes/repair-kbd-memory-rest-contract/* into openspec/changes/archive/. The file tree shows skill-distribution generators (scripts/generate-skill-system-distribution.js, scripts/codex-sync-skills.sh, scripts/install-skills-flat.sh) and distribution targets (.claude-plugin/skills, .agents/skills, .codex/skills, .cursor/skills, skill-system.json), none of which are touched in the diff. The change's own refinement log (.refiner/artifacts/repair-kbd-memory-rest-contract/refinement_log.md) records C-01 as 'DEFERRED / NON-BLOCKING', but the constraints document contains no deferral provision, and the QA-skip provisions ('fewer than 3 files modified, documentation-only changes, or --skip-qa') do not apply to a 20+ file code change.
findings.suggested_fix: Either amend the constraints to explicitly permit batched regeneration under reconcile-kbd-control-plane-projections, or run the skill distribution generators and commit the outputs before the archived change is treated as closed.

findings.claim: The canonical tracker marks harden-uiux-routing-discovery DONE/COMPLETE even though the latest committed adversarial verdict for it is BLOCK and no passing re-review receipt exists; the resolution document itself records re-review, verification, and archival as still pending.
findings.evidence: progress.json sets harden-uiux-routing-discovery to "status": "DONE", "implementation_status": "COMPLETE", "tasks_done": 6/6, and position.json mirrors "status": "COMPLETE". But the newest committed review artifact in the same diff, review/harden-uiux-routing-discovery/findings-round-2.json, carries "verdict": "BLOCK" with two CRITICAL findings, review/harden-uiux-routing-discovery/rejection-round-2.md is committed empty (index e69de29), and resolution.md states 'Proceed to the bounded adversarial re-review, OpenSpec verification, and archival' — i.e., the mandatory re-review had not produced a PASS when the tracker was set DONE.
findings.suggested_fix: Only transition the change to DONE/COMPLETE after the re-review verdict artifact shows PASS (or record the BLOCK-to-DONE transition with an explicit signed override receipt in the review directory).

findings.claim: A zero-byte rejection-round-2.md is committed as the round-2 gate receipt while round 1's receipt contains the sycophancy-screen result, leaving the round-2 screen outcome undocumented in the expected location.
findings.evidence: The diff adds rejection-round-2.md with index e69de29 (the well-known empty-blob hash), whereas rejection.md for round 1 contains '[adv-gate] PASS (score=...)'. The round-2 screen score exists only inside findings-round-2.json's sycophancy_screen block, not in the receipt file that the naming convention reserves for it.
findings.suggested_fix: Either populate rejection-round-2.md with the round-2 gate result or remove the empty file so the review directory contains only meaningful receipts.
